name: html-preview
description: Shows HTML files Claude writes (or /preview <file>) like a browser: terminal-browser when installed, else a built-in Chrome-rendered pane

mode.title: Where to show the page
mode.description: auto: terminal-browser plugin pane, else terminal-browser CLI split, else the built-in renderer; pane / split: terminal-browser only; builtin: headless Chrome screenshot in a Claude Code pane, no terminal-browser needed

split.title: Split direction
split.description: Direction for the CLI split (mode split, or auto without the plugin)

autoOpen.title: Auto-open written HTML
autoOpen.description: Preview each .html file the Write or Edit tool saves

chromePath.title: Chrome path
chromePath.description: Chrome/Chromium binary for the built-in renderer; empty finds one
